notes.title: Velocity G post launch update
notes.content:
We listened to your feedback and are pleased to release our first update to Velocity G.  

This update addresses many of the issues raised out and includes:

[list]
[*] [b]Shorter, but more dynamic tracks [/b]- Tracks are now shorter, faster and more exciting to race on.
[*] [b]Improved AI difficulty [/b]- AI opponents difficulty has been tweaked on the earlier levels as it seemed they were just too easy to beat.
[*] [b]Weapons [/b]- New pickups are scattered around the tracks that enable weapons, shields and on demand boosts.
[*] [b]Obstacles [/b]- A range of moving obstacles have been introduced, that require careful timing and skill to negotiate.
[*] [b]General bugfixes and improvements [/b]
[/list]

We hope you like the additions and improvements in this update and look forward to bringing you more.
